entities.name: Ibn al-Sikkit
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū Yūsuf Ya‘qūb Ibn as-Sikkīt was a Persian philologist tutor to the son of the Abbasid caliph Al-Mutawakkil and a great grammarian and scholar of poetry of the al-Kūfah school. He was punished on the orders of the caliph and died between 857 and 861.
